title: QWATT normalized interval record
description: What every ingestion adapter (Modbus RTU/TCP, HTTP/JSON push, CSV replay) emits, and the only shape the gate engine accepts. A meter is supported by writing a register map that produces this — never by editing the engine. Every numeric field is an integer (milliwatt-hours, milliwatts, seconds) so the canonical JSON hashes identically in every language; see docs/ARCHITECTURE-FREEZE.md §1. v1.1.0 replaced the floating-point `wh`/`w_mean` of v1.0.0 with integer `mwh`/`mw_mean`.

spec_version.description: gates.spec.json version the node was configured with.

node_id.description: Node identity — the public key of the node's signing key once nodes sign.

seq.description: Strictly increasing per node. Replay protection.

ts_start.description: Interval start, RFC 3339 UTC, aligned to a multiple of dt_s from the epoch.

ts_end.description: Interval end, RFC 3339 UTC. Must be after ts_start.

dt_s.description: Interval length in seconds. Must equal ts_end − ts_start within 1 s.

clock_skew_s.description: Gateway receive time − ts_end, whole seconds. Filled in by the gateway, absent at the node.

meters.description: Two independent instruments. In symmetric profiles both measure the same DC quantity. In ac_dc_ratio profiles `a` is DC before the inverter and `b` is AC after it.

register_map.description: Name of the register-map config that produced this record, e.g. `pzem-017@1`.

raw_sha256.description: Hash of the raw adapter payload, kept so the normalization itself is auditable.

mw_mean.description: Mean power over the interval, milliwatts. Optional; enables the energy/power consistency check.

samples.description: Number of raw samples integrated into mwh.
